jp_sentences: きのう、友だちと山へ行った。
もし天気がよかったら、しゃしんをたくさんとりたかった。
でも、あさから雨がふって、とてもさむかった。
かさをもって行けばよかった。
もし今度また行ったら、天気をよく見てから出かけるつもりだ。
jp: きのう、友だちと山へ行った。もし天気がよかったら、しゃしんをたくさんとりたかった。でも、あさから雨がふって、とてもさむかった。かさをもって行けばよかった。もし今度また行ったら、天気をよく見てから出かけるつもりだ。
translation_pt: Ontem fui à montanha com um amigo. Se o tempo estivesse bom, eu queria ter tirado um monte de foto. Mas choveu desde cedo e fez muito frio. Eu devia ter levado guarda-chuva. Se eu for de novo, pretendo conferir bem o tempo antes de sair.
translation_pt_sentences: Ontem fui à montanha com um amigo.
Se o tempo estivesse bom, eu queria ter tirado um monte de foto.
Mas choveu desde cedo e fez muito frio.
Se eu for de novo, pretendo conferir bem o tempo antes de sair.
translation_en: Yesterday I went to the mountains with a friend. If the weather had been good, I would have wanted to take lots of photos. But it rained from the morning on and it was really cold. I should have brought an umbrella. If I go again next time, I plan to check the weather carefully before heading out.
translation_en_sentences: Yesterday I went to the mountains with a friend.
If the weather had been good, I would have wanted to take lots of photos.
But it rained from the morning on and it was really cold.
I should have brought an umbrella.
If I go again next time, I plan to check the weather carefully before heading out.
